issue.title: Record the decision that reference reading state is derived and the library verbs are read-only

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add an accepted record to the `decisions` memory web (for example `decisions/ref-reading-state-is-derived.md`): "Reference reading state is derived and the library verbs are read-only". Proposed by phase bob-cli-4w.11 (note #3) of epic bob-cli-4w, recorded by bob-cli-4w.land.

Claim: `bob ref find`, `list`, and `show` never write, run hooks, or open PDFs (the one exception is `find -i`, which reads intake PDF markers). `reading_state` (queued/started/finished/dropped/unknown) is derived at read time from the `^ref` tracker mark, the frontmatter `status`, or `legacy_status`, each row carries `reading_state_source` as evidence, and no field ever asserts "never read". The `^ref` checkbox plus `bob ref scan`/`sync` stay the only writers of reading state. Supersession of a PDF-less note by a PDF-backed note with a shared identity key is inferred, not stored.

Evidence: plan `plan:202610/bob_ref_reference_library.md` design decisions 2, 3, and 5; research `research:202610/bob_ref_reference_library_migration/bob_ref_reference_library_migration.md`; commits 7b60ded, 87498c7, 3642b4a, e3e69df; `docs/ref.md`. Rejected alternatives in the plan: a stored review/reading field, `supersedes:` marker fields, and write verbs (mark/track/adopt/set-status). Ask Bryan for anything the plan does not record.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-4w's plan asked its verify phase to propose this decisions record; bob-cli-4w.11 note #3 recorded it, and no decisions record yet governs the new bob ref library verbs.
